findings.title: Archive the supplied reviews verbatim, including scores, corrections, allegations, recommendations, and qualifications.
findings.acceptance: Original text comparison and SHA-256; no reconstructed summary presented as the original.
findings.baselineClassification: Exact user payload recovered; archive digest verified.

findings.title: Reconcile every criticism against current source and evidence.
findings.acceptance: Each source finding maps to a stable ID classified as confirmed, historical, partially resolved, unverified, or externally dependent.

evidence.method: Manual reconciliation of preserved critic references against current source and deployment evidence; reviewed all27 accepted outcomes.

findings.baselineClassification: Three critic reviews reconciled against baseline63ecc77; historic scores preserved and not recomputed.

findings.title: Establish one release identity per environment.
findings.acceptance: Immutable source tag → lock/toolchain hashes → build → circuit/vendor/reviewer hashes → contracts → deployment → audits.
findings.baselineClassification: Partial: latest code/audit deployment aligned, but immutable two-environment release chain not established.

findings.title: Make canonical origins and availability authoritative.
findings.acceptance: Health identity matches deployment; DNS, HTTPS, browser, and core routes pass from three independent environments.
findings.baselineClassification: Partial: canonical URL reachable in this session; three independent current availability checks outstanding.

findings.title: Standardize manifests and validate raw JSON before parsing.
findings.acceptance: Addresses, transaction hashes, and code hashes are unambiguous; a deliberately duplicated key fails validation.

evidence.scope: Parser primitive; final release manifest verification pending

findings.baselineClassification: Allegation refuted for current12 manifests: strict parser found no duplicate keys. Canonical schema and negative controls outstanding.

findings.title: Repair clean-install and Docker execution.
findings.acceptance: Exact locked toolchain installs in a clean environment; web target serves HTTP; worker target processes its queue.
findings.baselineClassification: Confirmed: Docker builds web and starts worker; clean-machine packaging remains unverified.

findings.title: Harden GitHub Actions reproducibility and secrets access.
findings.acceptance: Actions pinned to commit SHAs; tool versions pinned; minimal permissions; untrusted PR jobs cannot access execution secrets.
findings.baselineClassification: Confirmed: mutable action tags and unpinned toolchains remain.

findings.title: Implement strict environment isolation throughout API, contracts, scripts, SDK, and workers.
findings.acceptance: Cross-environment credentials, databases, receipts, routes, and signing operations are rejected.
findings.baselineClassification: Confirmed: default live configuration combines mainnet asset with Studio review; worker explicitly permits testnet only.

findings.title: Create the new mainnet database and least-privilege principals.
findings.acceptance: Empty initial database, verified indexes, bounded connection behavior, denied testnet access, and successful backup/restore exercise.
findings.baselineClassification: New requirement: mainnet database does not exist in tracked evidence; runtime currently defaults to a shared database name.

findings.title: Verify both mainnet assets and all ten CCTP routes.
findings.acceptance: Issuer provenance, chain identity, code/implementation hashes, decimals, messenger relationships, domains, pauses, fees, and route mappings.

evidence.scope: 17 parent-verified registry/tooling regressions. Exploratory live snapshots are not a release capability.

findings.baselineClassification: Partial: native-USDC testnet routes verified; official mainnet assets and ten destination routes require expanded live proof.

findings.title: Complete reviewer preflight, citation, commitment, and network handling.
findings.acceptance: Deterministic failures avoid model generation; validators independently verify results; malformed/finally failed receipts cannot authorize payment.

evidence.scope: 206 direct SDK tests, parent reverified; runtime and live audits pending

findings.baselineClassification: Partial: receipt-normalization and prohibited-purpose rejection proved; new reviewer network/asset profile and broad injection reliability outstanding.

findings.title: Provide explicit replacement for legacy reviewers.
findings.acceptance: Owner creates a replacement card, verifies policy/reviewer, rotates credentials, and withdraws/redeposits available funds; pending reservations and old history remain intact.
findings.baselineClassification: Confirmed limitation: legacy funded reviewers remain immutable and unrepaired; explicit replacement required.

findings.title: Run fresh adversarial semantic and reliability audits.
findings.acceptance: Two independent runs with fresh evidence, expected finalized outcomes, public receipts, and declared latency/failure thresholds.
findings.baselineClassification: Partial: newer native-USDC audit8/8; original audit10/12 unchanged; fresh injection/reliability matrix outstanding.

findings.title: Eliminate unexplained stuck execution states.
findings.acceptance: Durable wake, retry, lease recovery, cancellation, and progress reporting pass crash/outage tests; terminal states stop showing pending review.
findings.baselineClassification: Partial: durable recovery exists; absolute deadlines, stalled-stage diagnosis and comprehensive outage/race proof outstanding.

findings.title: Complete CCTP receipt proof and reconciliation.
findings.acceptance: Source burn, raw message, Iris response, destination mint, amount/recipient/domain checks, balance evidence, nonce consumption, and signed acknowledgement.
findings.baselineClassification: Partial: three testnet deliveries independently verified; full raw attestation and route proof must become per-payment protocol output.

findings.title: Test and document attestor compromise and operational controls.
findings.acceptance: Forged/mismatched acknowledgements fail worker verification; signature replay fails; rotation and emergency pause are exercised; remaining trust is explicit.
findings.baselineClassification: Architectural trust boundary confirmed; not a demonstrated fund-draining exploit. Compromise, key rotation and incident scenarios outstanding.

findings.title: Perform the adversarial security audit, repair defects, and retest.
findings.acceptance: Reproductions, regression tests, fix commits, deployed verification, and a final scoped report with no unresolved confirmed security defects.
findings.baselineClassification: No zero-vulnerability claim. Existing tests are not a comprehensive adversarial audit; TapeCode applicability is externally unverified.

findings.title: Deploy the circuit through official TapeOut mainnet infrastructure.
findings.acceptance: CPU/circuit identifiers, transaction receipts, processor and beacon pins, vendor provenance, and independently reproduced live vectors.
findings.baselineClassification: Meaningful testnet unchanged-NetlistVM adapter proven; official mainnet CPU and circuit registration not deployed by IntentGuard.

findings.title: Publish the frontend through X Layer DeWEB.
findings.acceptance: Verified container/name, file hashes, resumed chunk uploads, working routes, wallet login, API permissions, and gateway compatibility.
findings.baselineClassification: Official TapeKit source and mainnet code establish X Layer static hosting support; application frontend not published there.

findings.title: Preserve and verify existing product features.
findings.acceptance: Real latest-three transactions, accurate downloads, unique icon/logo, wallet login, explorer, sectioned docs, story animation/audio, and reduced-motion behavior.
findings.baselineClassification: Partial: hosted identity/media/docs/card checks previously passed; preserve these while introducing isolated environments.

findings.title: Synchronize protocol documentation and agent tooling.
findings.acceptance: README, OpenAPI, SDK, MCP resources, skills, and machine-readable guides agree and support integration without a separate docs link.
findings.baselineClassification: Partial: existing SDK/MCP/skills/docs exist; environment and mainnet interfaces need synchronization.

findings.title: Sharpen positioning and first-use flow.
findings.acceptance: A visitor reaches a real paid or blocked record within 60 seconds without connecting a wallet; setup remains resumable.
findings.baselineClassification: Confirmed product concern: narrow initial buyer and faster real-record walkthrough need validation.

findings.title: Publish measured operating costs and explicit pricing hypotheses.
findings.acceptance: Review, RPC, Actions, database, gas, support, and hosting costs traced to measurements or clearly labelled assumptions.
findings.baselineClassification: Confirmed evidence gap: proposed revenue model has no measured production unit economics or validated price.

findings.title: Validate demand and recurring value.
findings.acceptance: Actual interviews/pilots, willingness-to-pay responses, repeat requests, retention, approval time saved, and false-positive/negative measurements.
findings.baselineClassification: Confirmed external evidence gap: no verified interviews, pilots, retention or willingness to pay.

findings.title: Produce the submission demo from verified records.
findings.acceptance: Video ≤3 minutes; every displayed payment, block, rejection, evidence failure, and replay maps to public release evidence.
findings.baselineClassification: Submission demo unverified; story animation is not evidence of live authorization reliability.

findings.title: Deploy and verify the mainnet beta.
findings.acceptance: Reviewed deployment quote, authorized spending cap, verified bytecode/configuration, real limited canaries, and isolated mainnet records.
findings.baselineClassification: New mainnet beta requirement: native mainnet contracts/data, GenLayer testnet review, ten EVM destinations; quote-before-spending retained.

findings.title: Reverify the complete release and findings register.
findings.acceptance: Every required gate has current evidence or an explicit handoff; both environments pass regression and hosted acceptance.
findings.baselineClassification: New integrated acceptance scope; all root completion claims remain pending.
